description: The latest written Chief summary (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or annual) for a project, or across all projects when no project is given (needs a connection to all projects). level.description: Which summary to read: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or annual.

project.description: Optional project id or exact name, to limit the answer to one project.
